## Universidad del Pacífico

**Teaching Assistant** (*Jefe de Prácticas*), Department of Economics · 2021 – 2025 · five courses · 23 course-sections

I taught my own weekly discussion sections, designed and graded the problem sets,
wrote the midterm and final examinations each term, and advised students through
office hours.

Universidad del Pacífico runs two full semesters a year, written **I** (March to July)
and **II** (August to December), plus a short intensive summer term in January and
February, written **00**. So *202X-II* is the second semester of 202X, and *202X-00*
is the summer term running from January to February 202X.

### Advanced Econometrics

[2023-II · 2024-I · 2024-II · 2025-I · 2025-II]{.row-meta}

[[Texts]{.label}Enders, *Applied Econometric Time Series* (4th ed.) · Greene, *Econometric Analysis* (7th ed.) · Wooldridge, *Introductory Econometrics* · Angrist & Pischke, *Mostly Harmless Econometrics*]{.row-meta}

[[Topics]{.label}Time series and unit root testing (Dickey-Fuller, Phillips-Perron), vector autoregressions, impulse-response functions and variance decomposition, cointegration (Engle-Granger and Johansen).]{.row-body}

### Introduction to Macroeconomics

[2021-I · 2021-II · 2022-I · 2022-II · 2023-I · 2023-II · 2024-I · 2025-I · 2025-II]{.row-meta}

[[Texts]{.label}Mankiw, *Principles of Economics* · Parkin & Loría, *Macroeconomics* · Krugman, Obstfeld & Melitz, *International Economics*]{.row-meta}

[[Topics]{.label}Aggregate demand and supply, money and inflation, the Phillips curve in the short and long run, fiscal and monetary policy, open-economy macroeconomics.]{.row-body}

### Introduction to Microeconomics

[2024-I · 2024-II · 2025-00 · 2025-I]{.row-meta}

[[Texts]{.label}Mankiw, *Principles of Economics*, with Nicholson, *Intermediate Microeconomics* and Pindyck & Rubinfeld, *Microeconomics* as supplementary reading]{.row-meta}

[[Topics]{.label}Scarcity and choice, consumer and producer theory, market structure, welfare and government intervention.]{.row-body}

### Introduction to Statistics

[2024-I · 2024-II · 2025-I · 2025-II]{.row-meta}

[[Texts]{.label}Newbold, Carlson & Thorne, *Statistics for Business and Economics* · Anderson, Sweeney & Williams, *Statistics for Business and Economics*]{.row-meta}

[[Topics]{.label}Descriptive statistics, probability, random variables and distributions, sampling distributions, estimation, hypothesis testing, covariance and regression.]{.row-body}

### Static and Dynamic Optimization

[2021-I]{.row-meta}

[[Texts]{.label}Chiang, *Elements of Dynamic Optimization* · Chiang, *Fundamental Methods of Mathematical Economics* · Sydsæter & Hammond, *Mathematics for Economic Analysis*]{.row-meta}

[[Topics]{.label}Topology in **R**^n^, convexity and the Weierstrass and local-global theorems, static optimization with and without constraints; the calculus of variations and the Euler equation, optimal control and the maximum principle, dynamic programming and the Bellman equation, including stochastic dynamic programming and log-linearization.]{.row-body}
